name: Power Platform Community Conference 2026
classification: Internal use only. Contains Microsoft slide images, some marked Microsoft Confidential, and customer-specific (CMS) observations.

themes.title: From assistant to autopilot
themes.text: Agents with their own identity, mailbox, memory, schedules; Scout rebuilt as cloud Autopilot.

themes.title: Workflows replace agent flows
themes.text: Deterministic steps plus AI nodes, inline agents, human approvals; predictable cost and guardrails.

themes.title: Copilot Managed Runtime: build anywhere, IT governs
themes.text: Managed host enforcing Entra, sharing limits, ACP, CSP, Purview, approvals.

themes.title: Simpler, Git-first ALM
themes.text: Project = repo; stages not environments; ~80% of apps stay in one environment; GitHub support.

themes.title: Operate with visibility
themes.text: Hourly alerts, alert routing, export, Power Pages health, agent inventory.

themes.title: Consumption-based cost
themes.text: Seat covers Chat; Cowork, Code, Autopilot, CMR use Copilot Credits; AI Builder seeded credits ended Nov 1, 2026.

themes.title: GCC availability is the gating question
themes.text: Most major announcements need a GCC timeline before we can plan around them.

themes.title: Domain knowledge comes first
themes.text: Understand customer domain knowledge before the app spec.

themes.title: Governance and security consolidating
themes.text: Security Hub, ACP replacing DLP, tenant isolation, VNet, managed identity.

openQuestions.question: How are AI credits configured?
openQuestions.answer: PPAC > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits: allocate per environment, overage, per-agent limits, alerts. Seeded AI Builder credits ended Nov 1, 2026.

openQuestions.question: What is 'Governance' in the keynote?
openQuestions.answer: Admin-center controls: agent governance in PPAC, publishing controls in M365 admin center, audit in Purview; Inventory under Manage > Inventory.

openQuestions.question: What is the agent map?
openQuestions.answer: Appears to be an M365 admin center agent view including unmanaged agents; requirements reported only by third parties.

openQuestions.question: What MCP touches Copilot workflows?
openQuestions.answer: Workflows can call MCP-compliant tools/knowledge servers as steps (GA July 15, 2026).

openQuestions.question: Does the URL drive prod vs test in CMR?
openQuestions.answer: Each app has preview and live URLs; deploy promotes a build to live; stage targets are an opt-in CLI preview; new targets get their own URL.

openQuestions.question: What CMR roles exist?
openQuestions.answer: Deck: Project Owner, Contributor/Agent, Approver. Creator, Developer, Read-only noted in demo only.
